view.title: Describing scatter plots
view.caption: Lakeview High: 180 students (fake data)

annotations.title: x: explanatory variable
annotations.text:
What we think explains or predicts the other one (hours studied).

y: response variable
The outcome we measure (exam score).

annotations.title: Direction · Form · Strength
annotations.text: And anything unusual: outliers and clusters.

view.title: How to describe a scatter plot

annotations.title: Uphill
annotations.text: More study, higher scores. r = 0.80

view.title: Direction: positive
view.caption: As x increases, y tends to increase

annotations.title: Downhill
annotations.text: More absences, lower grades. r = −0.70

view.title: Direction: negative
view.caption: As x increases, y tends to decrease

annotations.title: No association
annotations.text: Birthdays don’t predict exam scores. r = 0.02

view.title: Direction: none
view.caption: No tendency either way

annotations.title: r = 0.95
annotations.text: Close to 1: a strong linear relationship.

view.title: Strength: strong
view.caption: Points hug the line

annotations.title: r = 0.60
annotations.text: A moderate positive relationship.

view.title: Strength: moderate
view.caption: A clear trend, with plenty of scatter

annotations.title: r = −0.25
annotations.text: A weak negative relationship. The sign gives the direction; the size gives the strength.

view.title: Strength: weak
view.caption: A faint trend in a lot of noise

annotations.title: Linear
annotations.text: A straight line describes the pattern well.

view.title: Form: linear
view.caption: The points follow a straight line

annotations.title: Non-linear
annotations.text: The line misses both ends, even though r = 0.87.

view.title: Form: curved
view.caption: Big gains at first, then levelling off

layout.x: Hours of sleep the night before

annotations.title: r = 0.00
annotations.text: r is near 0, yet the relationship is strong. r only measures straight-line relationships.

view.title: Form: curved (both ways)
view.caption: Too little or too much sleep: lower scores

annotations.title: With it: r = 0.69
annotations.text: Far out in x, but where the line predicts.

view.title: Outliers: in line
view.caption: Far from the others, but right on the trend

annotations.title: Without it: r = 0.50
annotations.text: The line barely changes, but r drops: an in-line outlier makes the relationship look stronger.

view.title: Outliers: in line
view.caption: Remove it and see what changes

annotations.title: With it: r = 0.55
annotations.text: One student pulls the line down toward them.

view.title: Outliers: out of line
view.caption: Far from where the pattern predicts

annotations.title: Without it: r = 0.75
annotations.text: The line steepens and r rises: an out-of-line outlier weakens the relationship.

view.title: Outliers: out of line
view.caption: Remove it and see what changes
